```{r setup, message = FALSE}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, cmdstanr, here)
source(here("R/functions.R"))
source(here("R/synth_functions.R"))
```

```{r data}
patient_id   <- 8
patient_data <- load_synth_patient(patient_id)
patient_data

ggplot(patient_data, aes(x=Time, y = TumourSize/first(TumourSize))) +
  geom_point()

truth <- read_csv(here("synth_data/randSynthetic100Patients.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "unique_quiet") |>
  filter(PatientId == patient_id)
truth


  
```

```{r fit}
set.seed(3)
n_cycles <- Inf #Inf for the full history

#priorDic from the notebook. K is fixed at 1, so K_prior is not used
priors <- list(
  cost_prior     = c(1, 1),
  turnover_prior = c(1.2, 2.5),
  n0_prior       = c(2, 2),
  rFrac_prior    = c(1, 20),
  K_prior        = c(log(2), 0.8),
  rS_prior       = c(log(0.012), 0.6),
  dD_prior       = c(log(2.5), 0.6),
  sigma_prior    = c(log(0.2), 1))

fixed_vals <- list(K = 1)

stan_model <- cmdstan_model(here("stan/model_switchable.stan"))
stan_data  <- make_switchable_stan_data(patient_id, n_cycles, priors, fixed_vals)
pf <- stan_model$pathfinder(data = stan_data)
fit <- stan_model$sample(data = stan_data, chains = 4, parallel_chains = 4, init = pf, adapt_delta = .95)
fit$summary(c("cost", "turnover", "n0", "rFrac", "rS", "dD", "sigma"))

fit$diagnostic_summary()



```

```{r}
unconstrained <- list(cost = qlogis, turnover = qlogis, n0 = qlogis, rFrac = qlogis,
                      rS = "log", dD = "log", sigma = "log")

mcmc_pairs(fit$draws(pars), np = nuts_params(fit), transformations = unconstrained,  off_diag_fun = "hex")


```
